Ordinary prerequisites are Lyons--Peres Chapter 12.1 spinal identity; Janson [10, Theorem 1.3, quenched (1.11)] fringe convergence; Kortchemski--Richier [12, Eq. (12)] uniform height local limit; standard conditioned Galton--Watson local/scaling limits, Skorokhod embedding, random-walk hitting times/Wald and elementary continuous integral comparison. Every source-local rough comparison, arrival-time decomposition, truncation estimate and locality proof is included. The authors call the last continuous comparison at source 424 an easy exercise, after explicitly deriving its full integral inequality and continuity; this remains an ordinary comparison prerequisite, without an assistant-written argument. Literal source quirks such as the tree expectation sums at 299/301/343, the height-truncation bound mtn at 414 and final almost-sure closing at 498 are preserved without a mathematical verdict or repair.
